scope: Every Hotspawn CS2 fixture open for picks on the live lobby that the published snapshot leaves without a compliant betting-line pick: (A) the 2 unresolved fixtures in snapshot 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z, (B) the 5 future-start fixtures carrying only a Valve-rating research-model pick, (C) the 9 live-lobby cards added after that snapshot and therefore unpublished until the next automated collect. Research order per brief: HLTV first, then esportsbooks/aggregators. Hotspawn '% picked' and HLTV fan votes were observed and excluded; they are never probabilities. No snapshot row was hand-edited; guided picks below are published guidance with limitations, and the automated ladder (incl. scripts/egw_live.py) remains the only writer of snapshot probabilities.

method_notes: No-vig conversion: p_i = (1/o_i) / sum(1/o_j). Recomputed in tests/test_b72154e1_guided_picks.py.

Search-engine extracts are labelled as such wherever a first-hand page read was not performed; cached extracts carry their pageAge and are never priced as current.
